chapterTitle: The Exit Strategy: Know How to End Things
coreMove: Define the conditions under which a campaign should end, then honor those conditions before delay destroys the remaining terms of exit.
reversal: Some apparent exit signals are misleading, so the operator has to judge whether continuing truly costs more than stopping.
teachingEmphasis: set exit conditions before ego and sunk cost take over
leave while viable terms still exist
separate real deterioration from temporary discomfort
treat ending well as a strategic skill, not as failure by definition
